# Find & Sign Buyer Advocate

> Find & Sign is a boutique property buyer advocacy business representing buyers across Australia, with a focus on the Perth property market. The business helps clients identify, evaluate, negotiate and secure residential and investment properties.

## About
Find & Sign Buyer Advocate was founded by Niki Nakrani and represents property buyers exclusively. The business uses local market knowledge, property research, direct relationships and in-person property inspections to help clients make confident property decisions.

https://findandsignba.com.au/about

## Services
Find & Sign provides buyer advocacy and property buying support, including property sourcing, on-market and off-market opportunities, property inspections, due diligence, negotiation and settlement support.

https://findandsignba.com.au/services

## Client Outcomes
Examples of property outcomes achieved for clients through strategic property buying, including measurable property results where applicable.

https://findandsignba.com.au/client-outcomes

## Insights
Property market insights, buying guidance and practical information to help buyers understand opportunities and make informed property decisions.

https://findandsignba.com.au/insights
